scope: Leakage-free physical-control VACE dataset from accepted v6
summary: The corrected exporter produces 12 training and four validation clips with zero source-frame overlap, no target RGB in controls, and an independent robot-only identity image.
evidence: Every control contains calibrated depth, depth boundaries, the projected persistent stem centerline, and contact state only.
All source files are hash-bound to the accepted v6 simulation report; no Pexels frame enters training.
lessons: Control and reference independence must be audited in addition to split disjointness.
limitations: All clips share one simulated rollout and cannot establish scene-level generalization.
next_actions: Run a bounded VACE trainability smoke and fail-fast held-out comparison.
